description_en: Queries the databases that a user is authorized to manage
description_zh: 查询用户已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl32swayw7o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 3 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --database-name MySQL-8.0 --database-address 47.101.00.00 --database-type MySQL --network-domain-id 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabasesForUser

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to query
parameters.help_zh:
要查询已授权数据库的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据库实例名称
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the database to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_address

parameters.help_en:
The engine of the database to query. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain where the database to query resides
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询已授权数据库列表的网络域ID
parameters.name: network_domain_id
